Pick a mission from the mission library for the following building and write the crew briefing. Return: missionId, briefing text, and the chosen objective zone (name + rule).

Building details:
- buildingId: F1
- buildingName: Halvorsen Tower
- City: Los Angeles (Bunker Hill)
- Year Built: 1974
- Era: Analog
- Building Class: A
- Floors: 42
- Staging Floor: 22
- Guards: 4 (G1–G4), patrol 1 hop/turn
- Cameras: 2 analog-sweep CCTV on staging floor
- Locks: Key locks, pickable in 2 turns
- Entries: dock-N (loading dock, north), garage-E (garage ramp, east), lobby-S (main lobby, south, desk guard), exit-W (service stair B fire exit, west, alarmed), roof (roof hatch above floor 42)
- Zones on staging floor 22: 9 quiet vacant suites (2202–2210), 1 crowded occupied zone, 1 secure room (keyed door)

Pick the mission staged in Los Angeles that fits this analog-era 1970s Class-A tower. Write an in-character crew briefing (2–4 sentences) from the Game Master's perspective. Choose one zone on the staging floor as the objective zone and give it a game-fiction name and a rule for what the player must do there.
